summary: Frontend-only verification of 8 targeted bug fixes on the Come In Expo web preview. All 8 bugs PASS end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): Sign-in modal opens/closes, Delivery address row navigates to shared /delivery-address, address save returns to Account and updates hint, quick picks Home/Office fill the input correctly and persist on save, Home location-selector reflects saved value and modal input is pre-filled on open, /request Drop-to field is pre-filled from shared location with a working Change link, Change -> address save syncs back into Drop-to, and all three surfaces (Account hint, Home selector, Request drop) retain the saved address after a full page reload (AsyncStorage persistence works). Request submit regression also PASS: form -> submit -> success modal -> Done. One benign dev-only warning observed: 'GO_BACK was not handled' when tapping Done on /request opened via direct URL (no history); not a real bug. Non-focus regressions (cart stepper, services booking) were attempted but my playwright selectors were wrong (actual testIDs are 'stepper-{id}', 'cart-stepper-{id}', 'clear-cart-btn', 'book-{id}', 'toast-ok-btn'); not re-run as they are out of scope for this fix review and no code regression is suspected.
critical_code_review_comments: location store looks solid: trims input, falls back to DEFAULT_LOCATION on empty, migrates legacy raw-string AsyncStorage once, persists via shared storage util.

request.tsx uses a lastSyncedRef trick to overwrite Drop only when it still matches the previously-synced saved address, which correctly preserves one-off user overrides while syncing on change — verified by test.
Home modal re-syncs locInput on open via useEffect, preventing stale text — verified by test.
Minor: Request 'Done' button calls router.back() which logs a dev warning when /request is deep-linked. Consider router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/') for a cleaner UX, but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 on in-scope bug-fix + submit regression checks)

seed_data_creation: None. AsyncStorage was cleared via localStorage.clear() at test start to ensure a fresh 'Set delivery location' baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs referenced in the review request exist and work. For regression on cart/services, use these real testIDs: product add -> 'stepper-{id}' on ProductCard; cart stepper -> 'cart-stepper-{id}'; cart clear -> 'clear-cart-btn'; service book -> 'book-{id}'; service toast dismiss -> 'toast-ok-btn'. For the +not-found route, there is no explicit testID on the Go to Home anchor but it is an <a href='/'> button labeled 'Go to Home' and works correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all reported bugs are fixed.
